bio: Richie Rodriguez is a percussion educator and designer from Southern California whose involvement with the drum corps community began in 2008. He marched bass drum at Pacific Crest (2009-2010) and Santa Clara Vanguard (2011-2012), and has taught WGI percussion groups including Vanguard Winter Percussion and Pulse Percussion. Since joining the Santa Clara Vanguard percussion staff in 2014 he has coached the bass drum section, with the line earning the Fred Sanford Best Percussion Performance Award five times and a DCI World Championship in 2018. He holds a Bachelor of Arts in Journalism from California State University, Long Beach.

Robert Rodriguez is a color guard and visual instructor who has been teaching in the pageantry world since 2005. In the drum corps activity he worked with The Academy from 2015 to 2018 and most recently with Pacific Crest, where he was part of the color guard staff in 2019.

Robin Wells is an active color guard instructor in Ohio and a Phantom Regiment alumna who has served on Phantom Regiment's instructional team. She has been a staff member of Pride of Cincinnati since 2015, previously taught Zydeco Colorguard out of Dayton, Ohio, and has worked with high school programs including Miamisburg High School. She previously taught the color guard at The Cavaliers Drum & Bugle Corps.

Dr. Ryan Spencer is a trumpet player and brass educator who has taught drum corps and marching band since 2012. He taught the Bluecoats between 2012 and 2017, a span that included the corps' first-ever DCI World Championship. A Santa Clara Vanguard alumnus, he holds degrees from CU-Boulder (BM, DMA) and the University of Denver (MM), performs trumpet with the US Air Force Academy Band, and serves as artistic director and soprano cornetist for Colorado Brass.

Shant Keuroghelian is a visual and brass instructor who marched trumpet with the Blue Devils Drum and Bugle Corps (2007-2011), serving as trumpet section leader in his final year. He went on to serve as Visual Caption Head at The Academy Drum and Bugle Corps in Tempe, Arizona, and as Visual Caption Head for the Blue Devils, where he continues as a member of the instructional staff.

Steven MacAlpine is a color guard designer and visual instructor in the drum corps activity. He designed guard for the Colt Cadets in 2012 and was part of the color guard staff for The Cavaliers Drum & Bugle Corps, including the 2014 season.

Ted Tinker is a brass educator and the Assistant Director of Bands at River Bluff High School in Lexington, South Carolina. Originally from Buffalo, New York and raised in North Carolina, he holds a Bachelor of Music in Music Education from UNC Pembroke and a Master of Music in Music Education from UNC Greensboro. He performed with the Carolina Crown Drum & Bugle Corps (2013-2014) and has served on brass staff with the Crossmen (2016-2022), Santa Clara Vanguard (2024), and most recently The Cavaliers.
